sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।स्मितपूर्वमथो रामः प्रत्युवाच हरिं प्रभुः ॥४-११-८२॥।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।smitapūrvamatho rāmaḥ pratyuvāca hariṁ prabhuḥ ॥4-11-82॥।।

translations.english: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:
